_comment: Public circular-case resonance counts for all thermal midpoints H_i = Phi_min + (i-1/2)*(thermen_max*T_ref + Phi_max - Phi_min)/nenerg. The previous reference used the retired Phi_max + 0.1*T lower bound, removed by 3e46ec08df6ca2922bdf2b1a5b6fa43290bc0d93. Updated when repairing the cell-1 skip reintroduced by 8fcf370d7a1d3f7854a866249e170ba0b6c88b73. Independent oracle: resonant_int.f90 from its parent 4cff699, using the literal midpoint arithmetic before kinetic_energy_selection, built with the same dependency build as the candidate, reproduces these counts and the torque 730909562.23899949 exactly. potato_energy_cells checks the grid formula; potato_first_energy_cell checks thermal torque against a delta-normalized fixed-energy slice at zero potential. The golden test retains its count tolerances and sorted OMP=1/4 equality, and also checks the energy coordinates.
